target_audience.primary_persona: Gourmet salsa enthusiasts and food lovers seeking premium, artisan salsa products made with quality ingredients
secondary_personas: Wholesale partners (grocery stores, gourmet shops, retailers)
Fundraising organizations (schools, churches, sports teams, nonprofits)
Gift shoppers looking for unique food gifts
Health-conscious consumers interested in authentic, quality ingredients
pain_points: Difficulty finding high-quality, authentic gourmet salsa products
Limited heat level options in mass-market salsas
Lack of transparency about ingredients and sourcing
Need for easy fundraising products that sell well
Wholesale buyers seeking reliable artisan food suppliers
goals: Purchase premium salsa with authentic New Mexico-style flavors
Find the perfect heat level (mild to extra hot) for their taste
Run successful fundraising campaigns with quality products
Discover new recipes and ways to enjoy salsa
target_audience.usage_context: Online shopping for direct-to-consumer purchases, wholesale ordering for retail partners, fundraising program management for organizations, gift purchases for special occasions

product_vision.one_liner: Premium gourmet salsa e-commerce platform bringing 35+ years of authentic New Mexico-style family recipes direct to customers
product_vision.problem_statement: Mass-market salsas lack authentic flavor, quality ingredients, and variety. Consumers seeking premium artisan salsa products have limited options for direct purchase, and organizations need reliable fundraising products.
product_vision.value_proposition: Jose Madrid Salsa offers 25+ unique flavors with a 35-year family tradition, authentic New Mexico recipes, premium ingredients (California Pear tomatoes, authentic chiles), multiple heat levels, and established wholesale/fundraising programs - all with direct online ordering.
